Legal - San Francisco and New York City

**About the Team**

OpenAI’s Legal team helps advance our mission by tackling novel legal issues in AI. Our team brings together professionals across technology, privacy, intellectual property, corporate, employment, tax, regulatory, and litigation. Our regulatory compliance work turns legal requirements into practical programs that support responsible AI development and deployment.

**About the Role**

As a Legal Program Managered by recurring issues, with the mix evolving alongside team needs.

You will partner with counselation, coordinate partners, and move open questions toward decisions. As you develop expertise, you’ll take on more ambiguous projects and build repeatable processes that help teams work more effectively.

This full-time role is based in San Francisco, CA, or New York, NY. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

**In this role, you will:**

* Independently manage assigned legal programs and workstreams: define plans, owners, milestones, and dependencies within agreed scope, anticipate blockers, and drive execution.
* Translate counsel’s and specialist teams’ guidance into repeatable workflowsation gathering, and response coordination.
* Build strong partnerships across Legal, Product, Safety, User Operations, Policy, and other teams to clarify ownership, coordinate handoffs, and drive commitments through completion.
* Clarify open questionsation, synthesize partner input, and bring recommendations and tradeoffs to the appropriate decision-makers. Escalate decisions that require changes to priorities, scope, or resources.
* Maintain a reliable source of truth for matters, source documents, owners, deadlines, decisions, and actions. Provide concise reporting on progress, blockers, and decisions needed.
* Identify recurring issues and execution gaps, propose practical improvements, and lead agreed changes through implementation and adoption. Use tools and automation thoughtfully, verify outputs, and assess improvements in quality, timeliness, and partner effort.

**You might thrive in this role if you:**

* Have demonstrated experience independently managing programs or projects from planning through delivery in legal operations, business operations, compliance, policy, investigations, or a related field.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

**Case Manager**

**Essex Support Services**

**Senior Division**

**Agency Overview**

Felton Institute responds to the needs of our community by providing innovative, evidence-informed social services that transform lives. Our organization offers 60+ programs that address mental health, the unhoused, early care and education, those impacted by the justice system, transitional age youth, as well as aging adults. Our programs combine the latest scientific research with cultural sensitivity and a deep commitment to supporting and reflecting on the communities we serve. Felton offers a dynamic, challenging, and supportive work environment where we encourage the use of professional development, that staff can utilize throughout their careers.

**Program Description**

Felton’s Senior Division specializes in a full continuum of mental health services for older adults in outpatient clinics, the community, and supportive housing sites, as well as programs in employment training, economic security, case management, advocacy, and social connection and inclusion.

Felton’s The Essex Supportive Services Program provides on-site clinical case management, wellness support, and behavioral health services. Services aim to support tenants in maintaining stable housing and improving access to resources. Tenants are formerly unhoused adults with co-occurring mental health, substance abuse, medical problems, and limited experience living independently. Support services include clinical case management and behavioral health counseling, referral to and coordination with primary medical care, substance abuse and psychiatric treatment referrals, benefits counseling and client advocacy, meal programs, health education, community building, tenant organizing, and all other case management functions. Felton is committed to implementing evidence-based practices and behavioral health research within its community-based mental health services.

**Job Description**

The Case Manager provides direct service for individuals experiencing homelessness, substance use, mental health needs, and medical complexity. Under the supervision of the Lead Clinical Case Manager, the Case Manager participates in a multidisciplinary team, including external and internal agency team members consisting of mental health clinicians, primary care providers, nurses, peer specialists, interns, and psychiatric medication providers. The program serves 84 tenants at the Essex Hotel. The Case Manager holds a full caseload, evaluates the needs, and develops a treatment plan in collaboration with the tenants. The Case Manager provides specialized mental health services, rehabilitative skills training, crisis intervention, and case management services. Services may include connection to community resources, client advocacy, and engagement strategies. The Case Manager maintains accurate, detailed records of client contacts and incident reports as required by Felton, HSH, ONE system, and county and state regulations.

**Specific Responsibilities**

* Participate closely with an interdisciplinary team and collaborate with property management.
* Communicate effectively, orally and in writing, with all internal and external team members and with partnering agencies.
* Participate in intakes and service plan development for adults with a history of being unhoused and other psychiatric or medical conditions or disabilities.
* Recommend case management services, which could include connection to primary care, coordination with other providers and community resources, housing stabilization services, etc.
* Maintain records of each client contact or service in accordance with mandated standards of HSH and Felton. Meet requirements of timely access for client care and documentation.
* Participate in team meetings and case conferences through presentation of cases, discussion of issues, and exchange of information and ideas.
* Provide crisis intervention to prevent hospitalization and collaborate with other providers as needed. Respond to emergency situations as they arise.
* Develop systems and maintain ongoing training, including developing specializations in evidence-based practices for the teams.
* Accountable for data input into the ONE and CIRCE systems to maintain client records related to housing per HSH standards.
* Deliver exceptional customer service to tenants, community partners, and team.
* Provide activities and groups with the tenants.
* Advise tenants to basic needs, including income, housing, job training, insurance, and/or nutrition, among other resources.
* Recommend specific housing needs via training, coaching, or community resource referrals to support tenants in maintaining stable housing.
* Participate in emergency wellness checks
* Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Psychology, or related fields of study required.
* Minimum of 2 years’ experience in case management and mental health services with severely mentally ill, dually diagnosed, formerly unhoused adults.
* Comprehensive knowledge of mental health and substance abuse counseling, assessment, and crisis intervention skills.
* Willingness to work from a strength-based, harm reduction, client-centered model with an emphasis on evidence-based practices.
* Ability to work cooperatively on a multidisciplinary team, and to work with people of various ethnic and cultural backgrounds.
* Strong organizational, communication, documentation, time management, and interpersonal skills.
* Problem-solving skills: able to discern when to consult, when to make independent decisions, and able to offer suggestions for solutions.
* Experience managing crisis situations, skilled at crisis response, crisis de-escalation, and risk mitigation.
* Passionate about working with adults who may be isolated, have mental health issues, have cognitive impairments, substance abuse issues, or other needs that are not be

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

If you are interested in this position, please apply on Twitch's Career site https://www.twitch.tv/jobs/en/  
  
About Us:  
  
Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.  
  
We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.  
  
About the Role  
  
As the Senior Program Manager, Accessibility at Twitch, you will have a broad impact across all of Twitch and our Community. Reporting into the VP of UX, you will join our Design team where you will own the program design, education and enablement, and the auditing and testing output. We will look to you to execute the vision of how Twitch will be a welcome home for all regardless of abilities. You will partner with product, design, engineering, and legal to solve accessibility problems at scale and provide strategic solutions.
  
  
You can work from Twitch’s headquarters in San Francisco, CA; or from one of our hub locations in Seattle, WA; Los Angeles, CA; Irvine, CA; or New York City, NY - with West Coast (PST) working hours.  
  
You Will  
  
- Strategy & SME: Serve as the subject-matter expert for global digital accessibility across Twitch - advising product and partner teams, and leading process and tooling integration (including AI where appropriate).  
- Operations & Backlog: Own intake, backlog, and operational management - partnering with engineering, product, and design leaders to prioritize and drive core accessibility issues, with regular communications and reporting.  

* QA & Testing: Lead QA execution and manage QA specialists and third-party vendors; partner with engineers to build automated accessibility testing into CI/CD pipelines, shifting testing earlier in the development lifecycle.
* High-impact programs: Work with engineers, designers, product managers, and researchers to identify and deliver high-impact changes and programs across all products.
* Partnerships: Collaborate with accessibility partners (legal, research, policy, communications) on benchmarking, goal-setting, reporting, and execution.
* Education & Enablement: Develop an educational program and deploy guidelines and resources for key collaborators.

  
Perks  

* Medical, Dental, Vision & Disability Insurance
* 401(k)
* Maternity & Parental Leave
* Flexible PTO
* Amazon Employee Discount

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* You have 6+ years experience building similar Accessibility programs, QA and other scalable Accessibility Practices.
* Expertise in accessibility best practices, guidelines, and regulations—specifically WCAG 2.2+ AA and the CVAA; ability to advise the executive team on risk assessment.
* Experience working on consumer product accessibility both on video and communications products and across a variety of devices, such as desktop, smartphone, gaming console, and OTT services.
* Experience with Figma, Jira and similar relevant product development tools.
* Awareness of assistive technologies available to people with disabilities.
* You have experience creating and leading an accessibility program from ground up including creating, documenting, proactive management and driving deliverables.
* Experience working with and consulting product, design, engineering, and legal teams to deliver accessibility audits, code reviews and other advisory services.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Understanding of and familiarity with AI tooling and test automations for Accessibility
* Familiarity with Twitch as a user, streamer, or both!

  
Twitch is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. jobs.description:
**Location**
------------

Hub - San Francisco

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Location Type**
-----------------

Hybrid

**Department**
--------------

G&ALegal

**Compensation**
----------------

* Zone 1$133K – $182.5K

  

*Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.*

**About Superhuman**
--------------------

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs's collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

You’ll help run Superhuman’s unified audit program: quarterly audit activities across SOC 2, the ISO 27000 family, ISO 42001, and our other certifications. You’ll work with our audit firms, GRC Partners, and control owners across Superhuman, and plan new audits as we expand to new frameworks, platforms, and regions. You’ll also run gap assessments that show what each expansion will take before we commit.

You’ll build the audit operating model and runbook, and drive automation so evidence can be collected and reused across frameworks where possible, requests to control owners are streamlined, and each audit cycle takes less effort than the last. Building with AI tools is a normal part of the job, with appropriate human oversight.

This is an individual contributor role for a program manager who communicates clearly, manages competing priorities, and enjoys simplifying complex processes.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Run the audit program as one program: an integrated plan and calendar across audits and expansions, with milestones, dependencies, risks, and decisions tracked, and regular status updates to GRC leadership and stakeholders.
* Plan and run quarterly audits from scoping through report and findings closeout, including readiness ahead of each fieldwork window (control owner prep, evidence pre-checks, walkthrough dry runs).
* Scope each audit’s boundary with Product and Engineering, and flag when a launch or new platform changes it.
* Build and maintain the audit operating model and runbook as the program grows.
* Drive automation of evidence collection, request tracking, and audit reporting. Work with GRC Engineering on new ways to generate and collect evidence, and reuse evidence and walkthroughs across frameworks where applicable.
* Partner with GRC and Procurement on third-party risk management across the vendor lifecycle.
* Align audit windows across frameworks and firms to minimize duplicate evidence requests to control owners.
* Plan new audits and expansions, and run framework and scope evaluations and gap assessments with recommendations and effort estimates leadership can act on.
* Work with control owners and GRC Partners to deliver evidence and close findings, and coordinate with GRC Partners on findings requiring extended remediation.
* Manage day-to-day auditor relationships, and report audit status, findings, and program metrics to GRC leadership.

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------

* 5+ years of program management experience running multi-workstream programs with plans, milestones, dependencies, risk tracking, and leadership reporting.
* 5+ years running external security audits (SOC 2 and ISO 27001 at minimum), at a company or an audit firm, including seasons with several frameworks at once.
* Working knowledge of SOC 2, the ISO 27000 family, ISO 42001, and PCI-DSS and where their requirements overlap.
* Experience leading a gap assessment for a new framework or scope change and presenting the result to leadership.
* Experience building or improving an audit process: calendars, request tracking, runbooks, roles and responsibilities.
* Technical fluency to understand how evidence is produced in cloud environments, assess the completeness and accuracy of system-generated reports, and identify opportunities for automation using AI tools.
* Ability to communicate clearly, manage competing priorities, and proactively resolve blockers during time-sensitive audit cycles.
* Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, establish accountability, and drive deliverables without direct reporting authority.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience managing complex external audits in an in-house GRC function, consulting environment, or audit firm.
* Familiarity with additional frameworks such as ISO 42001, PCI DSS, ISO 27701 or 27018, CSA STAR, or international schemes (for example, IRAP, ISMAP, or C5).
* Experience automating evidence collection or audit reporting, or using LLMs day-to-day to plan, track, and report on program work.
* Experience with a GRC platform or building lightweight internal tooling.

**Compensation and Benefits**
-----------------------------

Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing the following and more:

* Excellent health care (including a wide range of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and fertility benefits)
* Disability and life insurance options
* 401(k) and RRSP matching
* Paid parental leave
* 20 days of paid time off per year, 12 days of paid holidays per year, two floating holidays per year, and flexible sick

* Facilitation: confident leading workshops and multi-day bootcamps for technical audiences, both in person and virtually
* Content Creation: the ability to turn complex product and deployment practices into clear courses, guides and hands-on exercises
* Assessment: the judgement to tell whether someone can actually do the work, not just pass a quiz, and the confidence to give direct feedback
* Technical Fluency: comfortable with core SaaS and AI concepts (APIs, integrations, LLM basics, automation logic), enough to speak credibly with technical partner teams
* Programme Management: organised and detail-oriented, able to run several partner cohorts and certification tracks at once
* Positivity and Engagement: a genuine interest in the work you do and a positive attitude!
* Curiosity: a passion for learning, for technology and for solving problems
* Adaptability: change is constant, and the Deployment Services Team values experimentation to find the best processes and solutions

**We're not a typical clinic.**

Cerebral Health exists for patients with complex neurological injuries — post-concussion athletes who aren't recovering on the expected timeline, accident survivors dealing with persistent vestibular dysfunction, people who've been told their imaging is normal but whose lives clearly aren't. We take those cases seriously. And we get results.

We're one of the few clinics in the region offering advanced neurological rehabilitation technology that most practices simply don't have. Our patients find us after exhausting other options. What we offer them is precision diagnostics, evidence-based neurological rehabilitation care, and a team that genuinely knows what they're doing.

Our team of 20 is collaborative, fast-paced, supportive, and united around a single mission — and that mission has real stakes. Our patients are coming to us to get their lives back. Every person on this team holds themselves to that standard: leading with a learner's heart, bringing compassion to every interaction, going above and beyond for the people in their care, and finding strength in working together. Since its founding by Paul Morszeck in 1898, RIMOWA has cultivated the pioneering spirit that is evident in every suitcase built. Inheriting his father’s visionary approach, it was Richard Morszeck who – inspired by the early days of aviation – discovered grooved aluminium as the ideal lightweight material for RIMOWA suitcases. A design classic was born. With the same ingenuity and courage as his father and grandfather, third generation owner Dieter Morszeck paved the way for RIMOWA’s global success. Thanks to his focus on state-of-the-art technology, uncompromising quality and timeless design, RIMOWA suitcases have become the global companion of choice for a sophisticated clientele. Today, with 3,000 employees worldwide, RIMOWA continues to combine craftmanship with precision technology and a commitment to courageous innovation, staying true to its heritage in today’s ever-changing world.

**About the Role**  
  
The Discovery team sits at the intersection of product analytics and operations within Uber Eats, owning one of the highest-leverage surfaces on the platform, how millions of eaters discover restaurants, grocery, and retail stores every day. This is not a traditional operations role. You will spend the majority of your time deep in data, writing complex SQL, building analytical frameworks, and running experiments that directly shape search ranking and cross-LOB placement across Uber Eats.  
  
You will be the analytical backbone for Search, partnering hands-on with Product, Data Science, S&P, Marketing, CRM, and peer Ops teams to translate massive datasets into actionable insights that influence ranking algorithms, drive experimentation roadmaps, and optimize how traffic is allocated across restaurants, grocery, and retail. If you thrive on navigating ambiguity with data rather than playbooks, and want to see your analysis directly move product decisions at scale, this is the role.  
  
**What You'll Do**  

* Own search analytics end-to-end: Write complex SQL queries against large-scale datasets to analyze search ranking performance, cross-LOB store and item placement, and conversion patterns across categories
* Build analytical products: Create and maintain dashboards, automated reporting, and monitoring tools that give Product, Ops, and Leadership real-time visibility into search health, ranking quality, and surface-level KPIs (conversion, GMV, engagement)
* Translate data into product influence: Synthesize operational and behavioral insights into clear recommendations that shape the search product roadmap, identifying ranking biases, surfacing gaps in cross-LOB allocation, and quantifying the impact of proposed changes
* Collaborate cross-functionally: Work across Product, Data Science, S&P, Marketing, CRM, and regional Ops teams to ensure search strategy is grounded in data and aligned across stakeholders. Serve as the connective tissue between operational reality and product development
* Manage programs and projects: Independently drive multiple workstreams from competitive search intelligence to new surface launches tracking details, managing timelines, and delivering in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift
* Scale shared surface governance: Contribute to Share of Voice frameworks and traffic allocation governance across Restaurants, Grocery, and Retail on shared discovery surfaces

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics) or equivalent practical experience
* 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, data analysis, or analytically-heavy operations roles

* Hands-on experience with Python or R for data manipulation, analysis, and automation

* **Location:** San Francisco Bay Area client sites
* **Employment Type:** Independent Contractor (1099), project-based
* **Capacity:** Approximately two project deliveries per month, with overlapping discovery, planning and closeout activities
* **Schedule:** Flexible planning hours, plus nights and weekends on move and event dates
* **Reports to:** Founder
* **Compensation:** Based on experience

**About Shift**

Shift Project Management helps companies plan and execute office relocations, decommissions and workplace operations projects, turning complex workplace transitions into smooth landings.

Founded by relocation specialist Pete O’Keefe, Shift takes a boutique approach: a focused client portfolio, attentive service and hands-on project leadership from discovery through closeout. We work closely with internal Workplace, Facilities and Real Estate teams to coordinate everything from vendor onboarding and scheduling to move readiness and opening-day execution.

Our services include:

* **Relocations & Decommissions:** End-to-end planning, budgeting, vendor coordination and on-site oversight.
* **Workplace Operations:** Setting up new sites, onboarding and coordinating service vendors, and establishing operational processes.
* **Special Projects:** Workplace activations, event logistics, signage and environmental branding coordination.

We make complex transitions easier to manage through clear communication, proactive problem-solving and organized execution, so clients can stay focused on their business and employees arrive at a workplace that is ready for them.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Project Manager to lead client projects from discovery through planning, on-site delivery and closeout. You will serve as the primary day-to-day client contact, manage project schedules and budgets, and coordinate the vendors and support teams responsible for delivery. The anticipated workload is approximately two project deliveries per month, with assignments and staffing based on project size, complexity and on-site requirements.

This role combines remote planning and coordination with in-person walkthroughs, site supervision and post-move support. Success means independently moving projects forward, maintaining clear communication and providing reliable coverage during critical activities while minimizing disruption to employees and business operations.

**Key ResponsibilitiesDiscovery and Scoping**

* Lead discovery meetings and site walkthroughs to define scope, budget, schedule, inventory and site requirements.
* Source vendors, evaluate estimates and develop proposals and scopes of work, including assumptions and exclusions.

**Planning and Coordination**

* Maintain project schedules, move plans, inventories and labeling instructions.
* Coordinate clients, building teams and vendors across IT disconnect/reconnect, furniture, storage and workspace setup.
* Confirm site access, dock and elevator reservations, insurance and building requirements.
* Prepare employee move instructions and track decisions, action items and staffing needs.

**On-Site Delivery**

* Verify site readiness and direct movers, vendors and support staff during load-out, delivery, installation and event resets.
* Manage vendor sequencing, resolve issues and escalate changes affecting scope, cost or schedule.
* Inspect completed work and track post-move issues through resolution.

**Budget Management and Closeout**

* Track budgets, vendor costs, invoices and change orders; obtain approval before committing to additional work.
* Confirm client acceptance, reconcile final costs and prepare billing records.

**About You**

**The Project Manager, People, serves a dual role:** leading the migration from HealthRIGHT 360’s current Human Capital Management platform to a new system and driving key initiatives for the People Department.
  
The Project Manager, People will lead the planning, implementation, optimization, and ongoing support of Workday Human Capital Management (HCM) solutions. This role partners closely with People team leadership, Fiscal stakeholders, and others to manage implementation and ensure a successful deployment of Workday functionality.
  
The Project Manager, People, will also support other key People team initiatives as needed, partnering with People team leadership to plan and implement changes to policies, procedures, and cross-departmental workflows to drive operational enhancements across the organization. The ideal candidate combines strong project management expertise with a deep understanding of HR processes and Workday capabilities to drive successful technology solutions that improve employee and manager experiences. The Project Manager, People will report to the Vice President, People.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
HR Business Partnership & Requirements Gathering
  

* Partner with HR leaders and stakeholders to understand business needs, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Facilitate workshops, interviews, and working sessions to gather and document functional and technical requirements.
* Translate HR business requirements into Workday system solutions and configuration recommendations.
* Collaborate with HR, Payroll, Benefits, Talent Acquisition, Learning, and Compensation teams to prioritize initiatives and enhancements.
* Develop business process maps, user stories, functional specifications, and gap analyses.

Workday Implementation Project Management

General Project Management and Coordination

* Monitor progress, manage risks, and propose mitigation strategie

**Employment type:** Independent Contractor (1099), project-based

**Schedule:** Flexible planning hours, plus nights and weekends on move and event dates

**Reports to:** Founder

**Compensation:** Based on experience

**About Shift**

Shift Project Management helps companies plan and execute office relocations, decommissions and workplace operations projects, turning complex workplace transitions into smooth landings.

Founded by relocation specialist Pete O’Keefe, Shift takes a boutique approach: a focused client portfolio, attentive service and hands-on project leadership from discovery through closeout. We work closely with internal Workplace, Facilities and Real Estate teams to coordinate everything from vendor onboarding and scheduling to move readiness and opening-day execution.

Our services include:

* **Relocations & Decommissions:** End-to-end planning, budgeting, vendor coordination and on-site oversight.
* **Workplace Operations:** Setting up new sites, onboarding and coordinating service vendors, and establishing operational processes.
* **Special Projects:** Workplace activations, event logistics, signage and environmental branding coordination.

We make complex transitions easier to manage through clear communication, proactive problem-solving and organized execution, so clients can stay focused on their business and employees arrive at a workplace that is ready for them.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a detail-oriented Project Coordinator who enjoys hands-on work, changing environments and seeing a plan come together.

You will support all projects across Shift’s portfolio, attending scheduled moves and events to help supervise vendors, check placement and resolve setup issues. While Project Managers lead their assigned projects, you will provide consistent on-site support across the team.

This is an evolving role with room to grow into project management. You will learn how to plan moves, coordinate vendors and support clients while taking increasing responsibility for project workstreams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Move Preparation**

* Support site walkthroughs and prepare inventories, photographs and project checklists.
* Print and organize box labels, desk tags, signage and placement instructions.
* Hang signage and confirm rooms, desks and destination areas are clearly marked.
* Review move plans, floor plans and assignments with the Project Manager before each move.

**Site Supervision and Move Support**

* Attend scheduled moves and events across Shift’s project portfolio.
* Provide on-site direction to movers and support vendors within the approved move plan.
* Check that boxes, furniture and equipment arrive in the correct locations.
* Track progress, flag missing or misplaced items and escalate to the Project Manager.
* Support furniture load-out, staging and workplace resets for events.
* Keep checklists and issue logs current, with photographs where needed.

**Technology and Workplace Readiness**

* Coordinate with IT teams to confirm equipment placement and completion of disconnect/reconnect work.
* Use client-approved checklists to check workstation setup and basic technology readiness; refer technical issues to IT.
* Check shared spaces, supplies and signage before employees arrive.
* Support unpacking, organization and post-move requests, tracking outstanding items through resolution.

**About You**

You notice when a label is wrong, a box is missing or a workstation is not ready. You follow instructions carefully, ask questions when something is unclear and look for the next task without waiting to be prompted.

You enjoy being on your feet and working at different sites rather than spending every day at the same desk. You are dependable, comfortable speaking with vendors and interested in learning how to manage projects.

**Requirements and Skills**

* Experience in workplace services, events, hospitality, facilities, logistics or another role requiring organization and customer service.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow floor plans, labeling systems and checklists.
* Clear communication with movers, building staff, client employees and project teams.
* Basic proficiency in Google Workspace and comfort learning project tracking tools.
* Availability to attend scheduled moves and events, including evening, overnight and weekend assignments.
* Reliable transportation to client sites throughout the Bay Area.
* Ability to move throughout project sites during extended shifts and perform setup tasks such as posting signage and placing labels, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Prior move experience is helpful but not required. We welcome candidates who bring dependable follow-through and a willingness to learn.

**Growth Opportunities**

This role can be a long-term fit for someone who enjoys project coordination, with flexibility for greater responsibility for those interested in advancing.

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Atlanta, GA, USA; Reston, VA, USA; Seattle, WA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management.
* Experience in data centers.
* Experience in cyber security, artificial intelligence, analysis, and process engineering.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in Task Flow.
* Experience with Lean, Six Sigma or similar methods to streamline workflows, cut cycle times and improve how well vulnerability remediation programs scale.
* Familiarity with data center critical infrastructure, including electrical, mechanical and cooling controls, and how cybersecurity risk turns into operational and uptime risk.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

As a Program Manager for Operational Technology (OT) Cybersecurity, you will support vulnerability management programs across the operational technology that supports critical infrastructure. These environments have tight downtime limits, safety concerns and complex vendor dependencies, so standard IT remediation practices often don't apply. You will manage vulnerability projects including end-to-end remediation, metrics development, and exceptions reporting. You will also drive the initial triage of Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs), judging exploitability in an OT context, checking applicability against the asset inventory, and coordinate with the OT Security Review Working Group to deliberate on a severity as needed. You will also build the program structure that makes this repeatable at scale, including tracking in Task Flow, SOPs and swimlanes. The role calls for strong ICS technical knowledge, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to turn technical risk into prioritized plans that protect both security and uptime.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $159000 - $230000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Read and interpret CVEs and ICS advisories from sources such as CISA ICS-CERT, vendor PSIRTs and Mandiant threat intelligence. Turn the technical findings into clear, actionable guidance for operational teams.
* Judge real-world exploitability in an OT context by looking at network exposure, the access an attacker would need, and device mode or state. Check advisories against the OT asset inventory to find affected devices, models and firmware versions, so remediation targets the right assets.
* Plan, track and report on cross-functional remediation programs in a project management tool such as Task Flow.
* Keep milestones, dependencies, blockers and SLO performance visible. Write and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Run triage decisions on critical vulnerabilities and send qualified findings to the right engineering, operations or vendor teams.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

### **Company Description**

**Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!**

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.

### **Job Description**

We have an opening for a Deputy Program Manager supporting the W80-5 Modernization Program. In this role, you will support the Program Manager in leading complex programmatic activities across the W80-5 program, fostering collaboration among diverse stakeholders, and driving successful execution of critical milestones. As a key leader within the Program Management Office, you will lead Earned Value Management (EVM) for LLNL W80-5 activities and ensure alignment with other sites’ program planning while helping to shape program strategies, ensure operational efficiency, and support the successful execution of a high-impact national security program. jobs.description:
**Position Overview**
---------------------

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to oversee commercial construction projects, including tenant improvements, building renovations, life sciences, biotech facilities, and ground-up developments.

This position will be responsible for managing all aspects of construction projects from preconstruction through final completion, including project budgets, schedules, contracts, subcontractors, procurement, and client relationships.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in commercial tenant improvements, renovations, and technically complex construction projects, with experience managing multiple trades, fast-track schedules, and demanding client expectations.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Manage commercial construction projects from preconstruction through final completion and closeout.
* Oversee project budgets, schedules, contracts, procurement, and overall financial performance.
* Coordinate estimating, subcontractor bidding, bid leveling, and subcontractor buyout.

* Ensure projects meet applicable building codes, safety regulations, quality standards, and contractual requirements.
* Manage project closeout activities, including punch lists, inspections, commissioning coordination, warranties, and final documentation.

* Strong experience managing commercial tenant improvements, renovations, or ground-up construction projects.

* Proven ability to manage construction projects from preconstruction through final closeout.

* Strong understanding of construction scheduling, subcontractor coordination, and project documentation.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organization, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and construction project management software.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience managing life sciences laboratories, biotech facilities, Class A office tenant improvements, or commercial building renovations.

* Familiarity with laboratory infrastructure, HVAC systems, process utilities, and specialty equipment coordination.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Architecture & Automation Deployment
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

Agilent is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the deployment of engineering tools, automation, and AI capabilities across our R&D organization. This role owns the full cycle from understanding what engineers actually need, to rolling out the tools and systems that meet that need, to making adoption stick. You will run internal voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions, translate what you learn into deployment programs, and drive the systematization and execution that turns a new tool or capability into something engineers actually use day to day.

This role also runs the program management behind Agilent's cross-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with our China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects. You will build and manage the program plans, governance, and reporting that keep divisional teams, the innovation hub, and the CTO office aligned as these initiatives scale.

This is a program leadership role built for someone who can move fluidly between listening to engineers, structuring a rollout plan, and running the execution discipline to deliver it. A systems engineering background is highly valued: understanding how engineering tools plug into the product development lifecycle and being able to speak credibly with engineering leads about technical workflows, will make you far more effective than program management experience alone.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Voice of Customer and Tool Strategy**

* Run structured voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions to understand where new tools, automation, or AI capabilities would have the most impact.
* Synthesize findings into clear deployment priorities and business cases, partnering with engineering leadership to validate direction.
* Stay current on emerging engineering tools and AI capabilities relevant to hardware and systems engineering workflows.

**Architecture and AI Deployment**

* Own end-to-end deployment programs for architecture implementation and AI capabilities across the enterprise, from pilot through full rollout.
* Drive systematization: turning a promising tool or pilot into a repeatable, well-governed capability that scales across divisions.
* Partner with IT, engineering operations, and divisional leads to manage rollout logistics, training, and change management.
* Track adoption and usage post-deployment, and course-correct programs that aren't landing.

**Automation Program Execution**

* Lead program management for cross-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with the China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects.
* Build and run program plans, governance cadences, and status reporting that keep divisional teams, strategic marketing, and the hub aligned on scope and timing.
* Manage cross-time zone program cadence with the China Innovation Center, keeping risks and dependencies visible to stakeholders.

**Cross-Functional Governance and Reporting**

* Maintain a portfolio view across architecture and automation programs, including status, risks, resourcing, and timelines.
* Partner with divisional program managers and engineering leads to resolve cross-program dependencies.
* Report program health and key decisions to the CTO office and other senior stakeholders on a regular cadence.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 10+ years of program or project management experience in a hardware/instrument R&D environment, including experience deploying tools, processes, or capabilities across engineering teams.
* Systems engineering background or hands-on experience working within a systems engineering process strongly preferred.
* Experience running voice-of-customer or internal stakeholder research efforts and translating findings into action.
* Experience with engineering tool rollouts, digital transformation, or AI/automation adoption initiatives strongly preferred.
* Experience running cross-divisional or multi-site programs, ideally including work with an offshore or globally distributed engineering team.

**Required Skills and Competencies**

* Strong program and portfolio management fundamentals: scope, schedule, risk, and stakeholder management.
* Comfort operating in a technical environment, able to hold credible conversations with engineering leads about systems-level and architecture workflows.
* Skilled at running voice-of-customer processes and turning qualitative input into a structured plan.
* Ability to build structure and process without slowing teams down, tuned to an engineering audience.
* Strong cross-functional influence and communication, able to align divisional and hub stakeholders without direct authority.

**Additional Details**

This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely. For many of our patients, a neurology visit comes with worry, and the first person they meet can set the tone for everything that follows. At INPM, a strong patient experience is important to our whole team, and it begins with you. As our Patient Experience and Access Coordinator, you are the welcoming face and steady voice that helps patients and families get the care they need and feel heard along the way.

jobs.description:
**Brailsford & Dunlavey (B&D) is seeking a** **Project Coordinator** **—an opportunity for a highly organized, proactive professional who enjoys keeping complex project work moving, managing details, and serving as a trusted resource to project teams and clients. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who communicates clearly, balances multiple priorities with confidence, and brings strong financial and project coordination capabilities to a fast-paced environment.**


This is a hybrid role based in our San Francisco, CA office.

**The Opportunity**

At B&D, we lead the planning, development, and management of the places that shape and strengthen communities—where people live, learn, work, and play. B&D recently joined forces with Project Management Advisors (PMA), bringing together two nationally recognized leaders in program management and real estate advisory services and expanding our capabilities across the full project lifecycle.

As a Project Coordinator, you will provide day-to-day coordination and administrative support. You will work closely with project managers, clients, consultants, contractors, and administrative staff to keep project information, financial tracking, documentation, meetings, and key deliverables organized and moving forward.

**How You’ll Contribute**

* Coordinate project schedules, deliverables, documentation, correspondence, and follow-up activities across project teams.
* Create and maintain organized electronic project files and project documentation in accordance with established procedures.
* Support project financial management by assisting with budgets, cash-flow estimates, commitment schedules, monthly draw packages, payables, and financial reporting.
* Gather and review information from project stakeholders to support accurate reporting and timely processing of key deliverables.
* Coordinate meetings, conference calls, appointments, and site visits; prepare agendas, presentation materials, and supporting documents.
* Attend project meetings, prepare and distribute meeting minutes, and track action items through completion.
* Support coordination among clients, designers, contractors, consultants, vendors, and internal project team members.
* Assist with consultant, contractor, and vendor solicitation, procurement, contract administration, and approval tracking.
* Monitor project details, scope changes, requests for information, submittals, and other information flows to help keep work on schedule.
* Support project controls and reporting related to status, cost, schedule, and open items.
* Assist with proposals, contracts, and project closeout activities as needed.
* Build responsive, professional relationships with clients and internal stakeholders while handling confidential information with discretion.

What we are looking for:

* 4+ years of relevant industry experience, ideally within construction, owner’s representation, program management, architecture/engineering, real estate development, or a related professional services environment.
* 2+ years of financial experience, including budget tracking, project financial analysis, reporting, invoicing, draw preparation, or similar responsibilities.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred but not required; coursework or a degree in business, accounting, finance, engineering, architecture, construction, or a related field is beneficial.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* General understanding of project management processes, project controls, construction documentation, and sequencing.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and produce high-quality work in a fast-paced project environment.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while collaborating effectively with a broader project team.
* Sound judgment, professionalism, integrity, and discretion when handling sensitive information.
* Client-service mindset and ability to build productive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

**What Sets You Apart**

You anticipate what the team needs before being asked and reliably follow work through to completion. You are comfortable working with financial and project information, enjoy bringing order to complex moving parts, and communicate confidently with clients and project partners. You stay composed when priorities shift, take ownership of details, and are motivated by becoming a trusted resource for the people you support.

Within your first six to twelve months, success will mean independently managing key administrative and coordination functions, supporting project financial tracking and reporting, and serving as a dependable resource for both clients and internal project teams.

**Why People Choose B&D**

**Impactful Mission-** Be part of meaningful work that helps shape the places where people live, learn, work, and connect.

**Learning & Growth-** We invest in mentorship, leadership development, and continuous learning at every stage of your career.

**Strong Culture-** Entrepreneurial thinking, collaboration, intellectual curiosity, integrity, and excellence drives how we work together.

**Robust Benefits-** Comprehensive benefits include 100% company-paid medical, dental, and prescription coverage, a targeted 7% employer-contribution 401(k), generous PTO, cell phone reimbursement and more.

**Apply Today!**

jobs.description:
**SYNAPSE SCHOOL POSITION OVERVIEW: After Care Coordinator**

The Synapse School in Menlo Park, CA, an innovative TK-8 independent school located in the heart of Silicon Valley, dedicated to rethinking and reimagining education, seeks an **AFTERCARE COORDINATOR** for an immediate opening.

Synapse educates a community of Change Makers by combining Social-Emotional Learning (SEL), leading-edge academics, and the practice of innovation. We have an unwavering belief in the capacity of children, and our teachers work alongside our students to unlock their powers of curiosity, discovery, and creativity. Synapse’s program provides a deep and unique range of integrated academic, social, and creative experiences to help children use their hearts and hands to unleash their passion for learning. Synapse draws students from around the San Francisco Bay Area.

Synapse is a place for people who like being in schools, who bring energy, perspective, and a sense that what we do for our students, families and colleagues matters. People who are optimistic about young people and about the world, who collaborate and communicate generously, and who approach challenges with creativity rather than cynicism, thrive at Synapse.

As a lab school, we are actively integrating AI and emerging technologies into teaching, learning, and operating. Strong candidates will be open to using AI as a tool for planning, feedback, differentiation, and innovation. Comfort with experimentation and continuous learning is essential; perfection is not.

Equally important, we’re looking for educators who model strong emotional intelligence and embody our Change Maker Outcomes: communication, perspective, risk-taking, follow through, creativity, advocacy, inquiry, feedback, and iteration. These habits of mind shape our culture and learning environment, and teachers play a central role in making them visible, practiced, and lived each day.

**POSITION DESCRIPTION**

Synapse’s After Care program and After Care School Programs give students a safe, engaging, and joyful place to learn and play after the academic day ends. Families depend on these programs being reliable and well run, and this role treats that dependability as the core of the job.

Synapse School has a full time opening for an After Care Coordinator for the 2026-27 school year. The After Care Coordinator will help manage Synapse’s After School Program vendors as well as Synapse’s internal After Care program, ensuring students are safe, engaged, and well cared for after the academic day ends. The role works closely with external vendors, Synapse faculty and staff who host programs, families, and the Business Manager.

We are looking for someone who loves kids, is highly reliable and safety-minded, is comfortable managing a wide age range from TK through 8th grade at the same time, is warm and engaging at the end of a long school day, and wants to be part of an exciting team of forward-thinking educators.

**RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING**

*Synapse After Care Operations*

● Design and lead the Synapse After Care program each afternoon alongside a team of After Care staff ● Staff, schedule, supervise, mentor, and support After Care personnel

● Plan and lead engaging activities appropriate to a wide age range, TK through 8th Grade ● Ensure the After Care space and materials are safe, organized, and well maintained

*After School Vendor Programs*

● Coordinate and schedule Vendor After School Programs

● Collect and organize required documents from vendors and instructors (insurance, background checks, etc.)

● Foster strong relationships with external vendors and internal Synapse staff hosting After School Programs ● Observe After School Program sessions and offer constructive feedback and support to instructors

*Safety, Records & Family Communication*

● Ensure the safety and joy of all students in After Care and After School Programs

● Maintain strict safety and sign-out protocols, including verifying authorized pickup ● Keep accurate daily attendance and sign-out records for all programs

● Communicate promptly and clearly with families about program logistics and any incidents ● Coordinate with classroom teachers on student needs relevant to after-school time ● Collaborate with the Business Manager on billing and payment for all After School programs

**AN IDEAL CANDIDATE WOULD POSSESS THE FOLLOWING QUALIFICATIONS**

● Experience working with a wide range of student age groups, and comfort managing TK through 8th at the same time

● Experience supervising staff or managing a program

● Undergraduate degree required

● Experience in an independent school preferred, but not required

● Highly reliable; families depend on these programs running the same way, every day ● Safety-minded, with strict attention to sign-out and pickup protocols

● Effective group management strategies

● Warm, positive, and engaging with students at the end of a long school day

● Patient and calming presence

● Proactive communicator and collaborator with excellent verbal and written communication skills ● Organized and able to prioritize efficiently, with comfort using a variety of online organizational tools ● Flexible and adaptable with creative problem solving

● Fluent in and able to model Synapse’s Nine Change Maker Outcomes and the Six Seconds emotional intelligence model (Know Yourself, Choose Yourself, Give Yourself) in daily work

● A passion to work cooperatively with colleagues on a consistent basis and actively cultivate an inclusive environment and support a school community grounded in empathy, social responsibility, and an appreciation and respect for individual differences

**SALARY RANGE AND BENEFITS**

$78,000 -$95,000

Synapse offers a generous benefits package including health, dental, and retirement, as well as additional lifestyle perks. Housing stipends available to those who qualify.

Applicants should email a cover letter of interest

(NASDAQ: FORM), is a leading provider of essential test and measurement technologies along the full semiconductor product life cycle — from characterization, modeling, reliability, and design de-bug, to qualification and production test. Semiconductor companies rely upon FormFactor’s products and services to accelerate profitability by optimizing device performance and advancing yield knowledge. The company serves customers through its network of facilities in Asia, Europe, and North America.

Rooted in our core values — Focus on the Customer, Ownership & Accountability, Respectfully & Effectively Communicate, and Motivate & Develop People — we foster an environment where diverse perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Everyone can make an impact here. Whether it's improving products, supporting customers, or positively influencing peers and the community, the contributions of our people matter.

**Shift:**

The regular hours for this position are Thursday, Friday, Saturday and every other Wednesday from 6:00am to 6:15pm.

**Job Description:**

The **Quality Assurance Technician 1** is responsible for performing detailed inspections and quality control activities to ensure products meet internal standards and customer specifications. This role requires strong technical inspection skills, proficiency with microscopes and measurement tools, and the ability to collaborate with engineering and operations teams. The Technician will support both in‑process and final inspection workflows in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Inspection & Quality Control**

* Perform detailed defect inspections of advanced probing technology products using the **Olympus MX‑50 microscope** and other precision inspection tools.
* Conduct **in‑process inspections** to verify product quality during various manufacturing stages.
* Complete **finished goods inspections** to ensure all outgoing material meets customer and internal specifications.
* Capture and document high-quality **inspection images** of components and products.

**Nonconformance Management**

* Identify nonconforming product and generate accurate, timely **nonconformance reports**.
* Partner with engineering teams to support investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective actions related to quality issues.

**Data & Documentation**

* Validate outgoing product data to ensure compliance with customer requirements.
* Perform accurate **data entry** and maintain up-to-date inventory information in the appropriate database systems.
* Follow detailed work instructions, SOPs, and documentation standards to maintain product traceability and compliance.

**Teamwork & Operational Support**

* Work within a shift-based team environment to support daily quality, engineering, and production activities.
* Contribute both as a collaborative team member and as an individual contributor to help meet daily inspection and production quotas.
* Follow a **compressed work schedule (3x4)** as assigned.

jobs.description:
Company Overview:

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

**Be part of a team that makes a real difference.**

Job Description:

**This is a full-time, hybrid position. The candidate must be located in the San Mateo, California area due to regular local travel for in-person patient appointments.**

**Perks:** Full and comprehensive benefits program, 24 days of paid vacation/holidays in your first year plus sick days, home office equipment including laptop and desktop monitor, mileage and travel reimbursement, Employee Assistance and Referral Program, and hands-on workers’ compensation case management training.

Join our compassionate team and help make a positive difference in an injured person’s life. As a Field Case Manager, you will work closely with treating physicians/providers, employers, customers, legal representatives, and the injured/disabled person to create and implement a treatment plan that returns the injured/disabled person back to work appropriately, ensure appropriate and cost-effective healthcare services, achievement of maximum medical recovery and return to an optimal level of work and functioning. In this role, you will:

* Demonstrate knowledge, skills, and competency in the application of case management standards of practice.
* Use advanced knowledge of types of injury, medications, comorbidities, treatment options, treatment alternatives, and knowledge of job duties to advise on a treatment plan.
* Interview disabled persons to assess overall recovery, including whether injuries or conditions are occupational or non-occupational.
* Collaborate with treating physicians/providers and utilize available resources to help create and implement treatment plans tailored to an individual patient.
* Work with employers and physicians to modify job duties where practical to facilitate early return to work.
* Evaluate and modify case goals based on injured/disabled person’s improvement and treatment effectiveness.
* Independently manage workload, including prioritizing cases and deciding how best to manage cases effectively.
* Complete other duties, such as attend injured worker’s appointments when appropriate, prepare status updates for submittal to customers, and other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

* **Education:** Associates Degree or Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing or related field.
* **Experience:** 2+ years clinical practice preferred. Workers’ compensation-related experience preferred.
* **Skills:** Ability to advocate recommendations effectively with physicians/providers, employers, and customers. Ability to work independently. Knowledge of basic computer skills including Excel, Word, and Outlook Email. Proficient grammar, sentence structure, and written communication skills.
* **Certifications, Licenses, Registrations:**
  + Active Registered Nurse (RN) license required. Must be in good standing.
  + URAC-recognized certification in case management (CCM, CDMS, CRC, CRRN or COHN, COHN-S, RN-BC, ACM, CMAC, CMC).
* **Travel:** Must have reliable transportation and be able to travel to and attend in-person appointments with injured workers in assigned geography.
* **Internet:** Must have reliable internet.
* **Transportation:** Must have reliable transportation and be able to travel to and attend in-person appointments with injured workers in assigned geography.

Benefits:

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $100,000 - $110,000 annually. In addition to the base salary, you will be eligible to participate in our productivity-based bonus program. Your total compensation, including base pay and potential bonus, will be based on a number of factors including skills, experience, education, and performance metrics.

jobs.description:
**Our Mission**

  

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you're blocked.

We're here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we've built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we're going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc's marketplace topower access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from *seeking* to *getting*. We don't want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

#### **Your impact on our Mission:**

Zocdoc's mission is to give power to the patient. As a Revenue Enablement Lead, you'll help our revenue teams build the product knowledge and customer insight they need to create better conversations and deliver more value to healthcare providers.

You'll own enablement for assigned Zocdoc products and healthcare domains—from launch readiness through ongoing learning. You'll also partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, and Revenue leaders to turn complex information into practical, scalable experiences that improve seller readiness and business outcomes. In this highly visible role, you'll shape how teams learn, adapt, and bring new products to market, thereby helping Zocdoc deliver more value to providers and the patients they serve.

#### **You'll enjoy this role if you are...**

* Energized by turning complex product and healthcare concepts into clear, useful learning experiences.
* Comfortable owning programs from strategy and planning through hands-on execution.
* Curious, collaborative, and motivated by building trusted partnerships across teams.
* Interested in using feedback, data, and experimentation to improve how people learn and perform.
* Excited to help revenue teams connect product knowledge to meaningful customer and business outcomes.
* Adaptable when priorities evolve, and thoughtful about balancing quality, speed, and scale.

#### **Your day to day is…**

* Leading enablement plans for product launches, enhancements, and new capabilities.
* Translating complex product, business, and healthcare concepts into clear, actionable learning experiences.
* Building and maintaining scalable programs using a mix of self-paced learning, live training, practical exercises, assessments, and reinforcement.
* Partnering with onboarding teams to help new hires develop the product and domain knowledge they need to succeed.

* Developing trusted partnerships across Product, Product Marketing, Revenue Leadership, and subject matter experts.
* Ensuring educational content is accurate and relevant as products, processes, and priorities evolve.

* 5+ years of experience in Revenue Enablement, Sales Enablement, Product Enablement, Learning & Development, or a related field.
* Experience developing and delivering enablement or learning programs that support product launches, seller readiness, or ongoing capability development.
* Strong instructional design and learning skills, with the ability to make complex topics easy to understand and apply.
* Experience managing multiple projects, balancing priorities, and delivering high-quality work in a changing environment.
* Strong cross-functional partnership, stakeholder management, written communication, and presentation skills.
* A data-informed approach to connecting learning goals with seller behavior and business outcomes.
* Experience with LMS platforms, e-learning authoring tools, Salesforce, Gong, or similar enablement technologies is helpful.
* Familiarity with healthcare, provider needs, or healthcare technology is a plus—not a requirement.

#### **Benefits**

* Flexible work environment
* Unlimited Vacation
* 100% paid employee health benefit options (including medical, dental, and vision)
* 401(k) with employer funded match
* Corporate wellness program with Wellhub
* Sabbatical leave (for employees with 5+ years of service)
* Competitive paid parental leave and fertility/family planning reimbursement
* Cell phone reimbursement
* Employee Resource Groups and ZocClubs to promote shared community and belonging
* Great Place to Work Certified

**About us**  
Zocdoc is the country's leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc's Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world's leading investors, and we believe we're still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.

  

Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. ### **About Mainspring**

Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power. The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Mainspring also partners with global energy leaders including AEP, NextEra Energy Resources, Schneider Electric, and more.

The core values that ground our work, guide our decisions, and connect us together:

* Pragmatic Optimism
* Excellence without Ego
* Proactive Collaboration

### **Job Overview**

The Strategic Materials Program Manager will be the operational linchpin for our most critical, high-value components. These components feature complex supply chains, custom manufacturing processes, and high field-rework value. To orchestrate material availability across diverse demand streams, you will leverage MRP systems and AI-driven forecasting tools to review historical trends, compare scenarios, and lead rigorous capacity planning. This role owns cross-functional communication, publishes regular planning reports for leadership, and partners directly with Procurement to ensure alignment. It is an opportunity to drive high-impact supply chain visibility from raw material mill runs to final asset delivery.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Manage end-to-end material flow and inventory visibility for critical components
* Coordinate and reconcile material requirements and allocations across multiple operational teams including Production, Project Delivery, O&M, and R&D
* Lead capacity planning and line of balance reviews with internal manufacturing teams and external stakeholders to identify and resolve throughput constraints
* Review consumption trends, build comparisons, and evaluate forecasts using MRP systems and AI-driven forecasting tools to publish comprehensive planning reports
* Partner closely with Procurement to review inventory coverage, align purchase order (PO) schedules with operational demand horizons, and prevent supply gaps
* Own cross-functional communication by gathering operational inputs and delivering transparent executive reporting on material health and schedule risks to leadership

### **Minimum Requirements**

* Deep knowledge of material requirements planning (MRP) and production scheduling logic
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data sets and demand signals
* Proficiency in managing ERP planning modules and optimizing system parameters
* Exceptional communication skills to bridge gaps between Engineering, Production, and Procurement

* 5+ years of experience in materials management or supply chain planning in a manufacturing environment
* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or a related technical field
* Advanced technical proficiency with MRP and ERP systems
* Proven track record of leading capacity planning, line of balance reviews, and cross-functional operations alignment with external suppliers
* Direct experience managing high-value, long-lead, custom-manufactured components or complex component lifecycles
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to present complex data insights clearly to cross-functional teams and executive leadership

**Please answer the following questions and submit your responses along with your resume.**
