jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

**Clinical Cloud Operations Analyst**
=====================================

**Location:** Remote, USA **Work Arrangement:** Remote **Anticipated Start Date:** January 2026

**About the Role**
------------------

The Clinical Cloud Operations Analyst applies working clinical imaging and technical knowledge to investigate and resolve moderately challenging, conventional application and workflow issues for assigned customers. This role evaluates diagnostic evidence and standard interactions among supported applications, PACS, databases, networks, and DICOM or HL7 interfaces using established methods.

  

The analyst manages assigned work under general supervision, independently completes familiar tasks within approved procedures, and seeks guidance for unfamiliar, cross-system, or higher-risk issues. This position contributes to requirements documentation, prescribed testing, and approved change validation — playing a meaningful role in ensuring clinical imaging operations run smoothly and reliably for the customers we serve.

**Your Role Responsibilities? Here's What You'll Do.**
------------------------------------------------------

* Investigate and resolve moderately challenging clinical application and imaging workflow issues — applying working knowledge of PACS, supported applications, Windows, SQL databases, networks, DICOM routing, and HL7 message behavior using established diagnostic methods, documented practices, and support processes.
* Review application logs, approved system data, interface messages, and customer-reported workflow behavior to identify likely causes — using documented checks, escalating conflicting evidence or unfamiliar dependencies, and maintaining accurate case records and troubleshooting documentation throughout the resolution process.
* Gather and document customer-reported workflow needs and issue details using established templates — confirming understanding with clinical users, customer IT, and experienced analysts, and recognizing observable effects on workflow, image or data availability, and data consistency.
* Serve as a primary operational contact for assigned customers — providing clear and timely updates on progress, dependencies, risks, and delays, while maintaining full case accountability through documented and verified resolution.
* Execute documented functional and integration test cases for assigned fixes, upgrades, or configuration changes — recording results and discrepancies, assisting with regression testing and clinical-user validation, and supporting approved implementations, upgrades, migrations, and post-change checks within assigned responsibilities.
* Collaborate with clinical, application, database, network, integration, cloud operations, and engineering colleagues on assigned issues — following applicable privacy, security, and protected health information handling requirements, and contributing to internal knowledge resources by identifying recurring issues and suggesting practical improvements.

**Role Essentials**
-------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience — with typically **2–4 years** of relevant experience in clinical imaging, PACS administration, healthcare technology, application support, or technical support.
* Working knowledge of clinical imaging workflows, PACS, DICOM, HL7, supported clinical applications, and customer support practices — with the ability to investigate standard imaging and message-flow issues within assigned scope.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Care Coordination
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Imagine Pediatrics is a tech enabled, pediatrician led medical group reimagining care for children with special health care needs. We deliver 24/7 virtual first and in home medical, behavioral, and social care, working alongside families, providers, and health plans to break down barriers to quality care. We do not replace existing care teams; we enhance them, providing an extra layer of support with compassion, creativity, and an unwavering commitment to children with medical complexity.

  

Families come to Imagine Pediatrics with real needs: a medication refill, a piece of medical equipment, a benefits application, follow-up after a hospital stay. As a Staff Product Manager, you'll own the systems that make sure each of those needs is captured, has a clear owner on our care team, and actually gets delivered on. This is how we turn our care model into meaningful value for families.

AI is central to how we'll do this at scale. You'll decide where AI and automation can take coordination work off our care teams so they spend their time on families instead of tracking, routing and chasing work, and you'll prove it with measured results.

Our care model blends virtual and in-home care for children with special health care needs and their families. The product you own is where care teams see what families need, pick up the work and finish it, every day.

  

**What You'll Own**

Product area: How family needs are captured, assigned, tracked and resolved across our care teams. That includes the shared view of patients and work care teams use every day; tasking and handoffs between roles; messaging with families by chat, text and email; internal care team communication; and follow-up after hospital discharges.

AI and automation in care coordination to:

* capture needs from family conversations and messages
* route and assign work to the right person
* prioritize what's most urgent
* summarize a need's history for whoever picks it up next
* flag needs that are stalling before a family feels it

You'll set the bar for where AI belongs, where it doesn't, and how we measure whether it's working.

* Primary users: Navigators, nurses, resource specialists, pharmacists and other care team members coordinating care. Families are users too, through the messages and updates they receive.
* North star: % of family needs resolved within target time. You'll also track how quickly each need gets a named owner, how many needs stall without progress, and how much care team time goes to coordination overhead rather than to families.
* First-year outcomes:
  + Every family need has a named owner and a visible status, and care teams stop working across fragmented tools.
  + One shared view of the patients and work each care team owns, prioritized by what's most urgent for families.
  + AI-assisted capture, routing or prioritization in production, with a measured reduction in coordination time and no drop in quality.

Other teams depend on what you build. Outreach routes newly enrolled families into your care team views, and the family app shows families the status of their needs. Your decisions shape their roadmaps.

  

**What You'll Do**

*Set direction in ambiguous problem spaces*

* Define the multi-quarter strategy for how family needs are captured, owned, worked and resolved across care teams.
* Frame problems by synthesizing input from clinical leaders, care teams, operations and data, often before anyone has named the problem.
* Turn open-ended operational problems into a clear strategy, and make decisions with incomplete information when waiting would cost families.

*Challenge how the work gets done*

* Push stakeholders to examine their operational workflows: why each step exists, what can be simplified or automated, and what won't scale as we grow.
* Don't digitize a broken process; redesign the workflow first, then build for it.
* Say no, with clear reasoning, to requests that don't move outcomes, and hold that boundary with senior stakeholders.

*Lead with AI where it creates real leverage*

* Identify the coordination work best suited to AI and automation, and the places where human judgment has to stay in the loop.
* Partner with engineering and data to take AI features from prototype to production, with clear evaluation criteria, safety guardrails and care team trust.
* Measure AI by the outcomes it moves (time saved, needs resolved faster, fewer dropped handoffs), not by what launched.

*Drive discovery and execution at scale*

* Own the full product lifecycle for your area using a build–measure–learn approach.
* Lead discovery directly with care teams to understand real workflows, clinical realities and operational constraints.
* Sequence migrations off legacy tools, make hard scope tradeoffs and ship improvements that compound.

*Lead cross-functionally without authority*

* Partner with engineering, clinical leaders, care teams, data and operations to design workflows that hold up in the real world.
* Broker tradeoffs between product, clinical workflows and operational capacity with senior stakeholders.
* Define how other teams plug into care coordination (how work reaches care teams and how families see progress on their needs), and influence their roadmaps where they depend on you.

*Own outcomes, not output*

* Own the success metrics for care coordination and hold the org accountable to them, for both family outcomes and care team efficiency.
* Drive adoption with care teams, not just launches: a system only works if teams actually work from it.
* Kill or rework what isn't moving the numbers.

*Raise the bar*

* Mentor other PMs and model strong discovery, writing, prioritization and decision-making.
* Become a recognized internal expert in pediatric care coordination and AI-enabled care operations.

First and foremost, you're motivated by improving the health and lives of children with special health care needs and their fami

**Summary** We are seeking a hands-on, systems-driven RevOps Manager to own the data, tools, and processes behind every stage of our revenue funnel: signup, trial, paid, renewal, expansion, and churn. ClickGuard will run four motions on the same stack: a self-serve trial, a sales-assisted motion for larger advertisers, outbound to advertisers and PPC agencies, and an agency partner program. This role makes sure a trial, a paying customer, and a dollar of MRR are counted the same way in HubSpot, Stripe, PostHog, and every report built on them. This is an AI-first operations role for someone who has personally built revenue systems that leadership used to run the business, and who uses AI to do the work of a larger ops team. You will own our CRM, our funnel data, the weekly revenue scorecard, and the workflows that move accounts from one stage to the next.

Your superpower is turning messy, disconnected data into numbers people act on. You treat RevOps as a data and systems problem first, and an admin problem second. Every workflow you build has an owner, a test, and an alert when it breaks, so a broken lead flow shows up in your inbox the same day it breaks and gets fixed before it reaches the quarter-end numbers.

Using AI tools is the baseline. We want someone who can show what they have personally built with AI, how it changed their workflow or capacity, and what measurable impact it had on data quality, speed, conversion, revenue, or headcount efficiency.

**What You'll Own**

HubSpot end-to-end: object model (contacts, companies, workspaces, deals, tickets), lifecycle stages, pipelines, properties, workflows, and permissions, with one owner per field and every critical workflow tested and monitored

The revenue data layer (built with our engineering and data team): the app, Stripe, and HubSpot feeding PostHog, with shared definitions for trial, paid, MRR, churn, expansion, and reactivation that every report uses

Funnel instrumentation and attribution: source captured at signup, account qualification by measured ad spend, and a clear trail from first touch to trial to paid to renewal

AI-powered RevOps systems at scale: build and operate workflows where AI materially increases throughput across enrichment, routing, lead and account scoring, health scoring, data hygiene, and reporting. You should be able to demonstrate systems you have personally built and the business results they produced.

The weekly revenue scorecard for the leadership meeting, pulled from source data; and the operating processes behind sales and customer success: quote and discount approvals, agency account handovers, refunds, chargebacks, and failed-payment recovery.

**You're a Fit If**

You've personally rebuilt a CRM that a revenue team relied on, and you can show the before and after: workflows fixed, fields retired, duplicate records merged, and reports leadership started to trust.

You have built real AI-powered workflows and can show what you built, where AI sat in the workflow, what it automated or augmented, and the measurable impact it created.

You understand subscription revenue well enough to reconcile MRR between Stripe and the CRM, and to explain why the two numbers differ

Hands-on with HubSpot (Operations Hub or equivalent), SQL, CLI, API’s, Webhooks, n8n/Make, and Claude Code or Codex

You can explain lifecycle stages, deal pipelines, and attribution models without Googling

You treat product usage as revenue data: trial activity, connected ad accounts, and plan limits feed scoring and routing

**You're Not a Fit If**

Your experience is mostly building dashboards on top of data someone else had to fix

You measure success in workflows built and tickets closed rather than conversion and revenue

You need a team around you; this role is the builder for our foundation

Required Skills & Experience

* **3-5+ Years in RevOps or Revenue Systems:** Proven experience owning the CRM and revenue data for a B2B SaaS company, ideally one with a self-serve trial or product-led motion. You can show the numbers: data completeness, workflow reliability, funnel conversion, forecast accuracy, and time saved.
* **CRM Architecture:** Concrete experience designing an object model, lifecycle stages, and pipelines from scratch, or rebuilding a broken one, including migrations that keep the history intact. You document every field you create and retire the ones nobody uses.
* **Data Ownership:** You have personally owned the path from source system to report: event tracking, warehouse tables, SQL, and reconciliation against billing. When two systems disagree, you find out why before anyone reports the number.
* **AI-Native Execution:** You have personally built AI-powered systems inside a revenue workflow, including enrichment, scoring, routing, classification, data cleanup, forecasting, or agentic workflows. You can clearly explain what you built, why you built it, how it worked, and what measurable result it produced in terms of pipeline, revenue, productivity, speed, quality, or reduced manual work.
* **Full-Funnel Accountability:** You measure your work through the full chain from signup trial qualified account paid renewal expansion. You can show examples where a process you built moved conversion or retention. You are comfortable killing your own workflows when the data says they are not helping.
* **Cross-Team Range:** Ability to work with sales, customer success, marketing, finance, and engineering: you write specs an engineer can build from and processes a sales rep will follow.

**Technical Proficiency**

HubSpot CRM Ecosystem: (Expert Level) Custom objects, associations, workflows, lifecycle stages, pipelines, properties, lists, permissions, and the HubSpot API.

SQL & Product Analytics: (Working Level) Comfortable writing SQL against a warehouse (PostHog or equivalent) and joining product events with billing and CRM data.

Billing Systems: Working fluency with Stripe: subscriptions, invoices, coupons, fai

Seamlessly, the AM will integrate with various teams and adapt to new challenges, ensuring that strategies remain agile and responsive to client needs.

* Closely partner with sales team(s), in owning the client relationship by: building solid rapport, demonstrating transparency, & delivering results against joint business objectives.
* Understand, manage, and anticipate client expectations, gain client alignment, and fully mobilize/engage partner teams against the aligned approach while maintaining a strong communicative relationship.
* Create a consistent open line of communication ensuring our value story & service successes are in parallel to a client's needs/goals via performance reviews (Weekly, Monthly, etc.)

* Work alongside our sales, and post sales optimization teams to formulate and act upon appropriate digital strategies and executions. These actions will aid in meeting and exceeding our clients' business goals.

* Ensure a highly consistent marketing message across paid search, organic presence, display, social media, and O&O digital/print marketing channels.
* Daily proficiency in customer relationship management, online search, and display advertising techniques and LocaliQ proprietary technologies.
* Review day to day campaign performance in collaboration with post sales optimization counterparts, assess digital campaign trends, facilitate client advertising performance discussions, & identify proactively creative new advertising techniques to further our client’s digital marketing needs.
* Hold primary responsibility for communicating and collaborating with backend support resources including, but not limited to, various digital solutions and ad operations teams, focused on delivering and exceeding client objectives (Daily, Weekly, Monthly, As Needed).

**Key Skills:**

* Ability to quickly master business process, marketing, and technology concepts
* Demonstrated expertise in customer relationship management
* Mastery of key technologies and systems to review and advise on digital marketing campaigns
* Advanced capabilities to effectively understand and speak toward digital advertising campaigns –Search, Display, Marketing Management Systems, traditional marketing endeavors etc.
* Strong technical skills to recommend, assess, modify/adjust, & routinely improve marketing campaigns over their lifecycle
* Demonstrated expertise with digital marketing publishing systems & processes
* Excellent verbal & written communication skills
* Demonstrate understanding of how retail/service media, sales, and operations work together to successfully drive a business
* Proven track record in relationship building and account management
* Works efficiently and is always looking to streamline processes & workflows
* Moderate Excel and PowerPoint skills required

**Key Competencies:**

* Marketing Concepts & Digital Marketing Acumen: pay-per-click, programmatic display, social, email marketing, and tracking concepts (Analytics/GA4), Leads, etc.)
* Customer Focus
* Proactive Creative & Analytical Thinking
* Business Proce

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst Trust & Custody
jobs.description:
As we continue to look for new solutions to improve our trust, custody and unitization capabilities our business is focused on reaching our bold ambition while we help people around the world save and invest so they can confidently achieve their retirement goals.

  

This role represents an opportunity to be at the forefront of transformation, innovation, and service excellence for our U.S. Retirement business within the Global Wealth and Asset Management (GWAM) segment. The Business Analyst – Trust Custody and Unitization will help to shape a new trust operations ecosystem including complementary tenets of people, process and technology as we integrate with a third-party sub-custodian.

  
  

We require a background and experience in mutual fund operations, process design, risk mitigation and a proven ability to work closely with various partners, and a strong desire to learn what is needed to properly support the business for the future.

  
  

**Position Responsibilities:**

* **Process Design and Improvement:** Design and strengthen the operating model for cash reconciliation and transitional processes, embedding rigorous controls, clear ownership, escalation paths, and sustainable procedures to minimize operational risk and ensure effective execution.
* **Training and Procedures:** Act as subject matter expert (SME) for trust operations including establishment of training collateral and procedure documentation. Work closely with the learning and development team to deliver training.
* **Risk Management:** Conduct thorough analysis to identify potential risks in operational processes and develop strategies to mitigate these risks, ensuring business continuity.
* **Performance Measurement:** Define and monitor KPIs to evaluate operational efficiency and vendor oversight. Continuously optimize processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
* **Projects:** Serve as lead on various trust operations projects, assisting in development of detailed project plan.
* **Reporting:** Prepare and present regular updates and status reports to management and partners.
* **Additional Responsibilities:** Perform other duties as assigned.
* **Requirements Gathering & Analysis:** Eliciting and documenting business and technical requirements for the team’s platforms and systems.
* **Strategic alignment:** Ensure tech solutions align with business objectives, working with product management and tech teams.
  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Proven expertise in FIS OMNI (OmniTrade, OmniDC, OmniScript), SQL, Excel and PowerBI tools.
* Solid understanding of mutual fund operations, and or retirement and or transfer agent record keeping.
* Strong reconciliation skills, cash and securities.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills; able to influence diverse teams and translate technical information into business value.
* Ability to think strategically, assess alternatives for short- and long-term impacts and act decisively.
* Strong influencing skills with ability to make sound recommendations.
  

**When you join our team:**

* We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
* We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.
* As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.

jobs.title: Dairy Solutions Specialist - Idaho
jobs.description:
### **Dairy Solutions Specialist**

**Remote, Idaho, United States | Full-Time | Exempt**

At Datamars, we help livestock producers make better decisions through industry-leading animal identification, activity monitoring, weighing, sorting, and data management solutions. We're looking for a results-driven Dairy Solutions Specialist to help accelerate growth within the U.S. dairy industry by partnering with producers to improve herd performance, labor efficiency, and profitability through technology-based solutions.

### **Why Join Datamars?**

* Opportunity to work with leading dairy producers across North America
* Industry-leading product portfolio and technology solutions
* Competitive compensation package
* Comprehensive benefits package
* Career growth opportunities within a global agricultural technology company

### **What You'll Do**

As a Dairy Solutions Specialist, you will be responsible for driving sales growth and expanding customer relationships throughout the dairy industry. You will work directly with dairy owners, herd managers, veterinarians, nutritionists, consultants, and channel partners to identify opportunities and deliver customized solutions.

Key responsibilities include:

* Develop and close new business opportunities within dairy operations, calf ranches, and integrated livestock enterprises.
* Execute territory growth strategies and achieve revenue objectives.
* Conduct on-farm assessments and consult with producers on operational improvements.
* Present solutions focused on animal identification, traceability, animal health, reproductive performance, labor efficiency, and data-driven management.
* Build relationships with key industry influencers, including veterinarians, consultants, nutritionists, distributors, and equipment dealers.
* Deliver ROI analyses and business cases that demonstrate customer value.
* Collaborate closely with Strategic Account Managers, Technical Services, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product Management teams.

### **What We're Looking For**

#### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Animal Science, Dairy Science, Agribusiness, Agricultural Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 3-7+ years of experience in dairy, livestock, animal health, agricultural technology, or related sales environments.
* Strong understanding of dairy production systems and economics.
* Proven success in business development, territory growth, and consultative selling.
* Ability to manage complex sales opportunities and multiple stakeholders.
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel extensively.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Dairy Science, Animal Science, Process Management, or related disciplines.
* Experience selling dairy technology, livestock equipment, animal health products, or herd management solutions.
* Established relationships within the dairy industry.
* Experience developing and presenting financial ROI analyses and value-based business cases.

### **Travel**

This is a field-based, remote position with approximately **50-75% travel** throughout the assigned territory, including customer visits, trade shows, industry events, and channel partner activities.

### **Compensation**

**Expected Salary Range: $90,000 - $190,000**

Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant industry experience, technical expertise, territory responsibility, demonstrated sales performance, existing customer relationships, geographic location, and overall qualifications. Because we are open to candidates with a broad range of dairy industry backgrounds, compensation may vary significantly within the posted range.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

DATAMARS provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: CX Training Specialist
jobs.description:
### **About the Company:**

At Playlist, life's richest moments happen when people step away from screens to move, connect, explore, and play. We're building the definitive platform for intentional living, connecting people with inspiring experiences in fitness, wellness, and beyond. With popular brands like Mindbody and ClassPass, Playlist empowers businesses and individuals, making it effortless for aspirations to become actions. Join us in reshaping technology's role to foster meaningful, real-world connections.

**The Role You'll Play**
------------------------

You'll design, develop, and deliver training that helps internal teams, customers, and external partners feel confident with Kite. Working closely with stakeholders across the business, you'll learn what people need most, turn it into clear learning objectives, and create engaging resources that drive product adoption, customer satisfaction, and stronger day-to-day execution.

* Build scalable training programs that support business goals and customer outcomes
* Create customer onboarding programs and on-camera instructional videos that speed up time to value
* Lead virtual training sessions and webinars for customers and internal teams
* Keep training content accurate and current as products, customer workflows, and priorities evolve
* Pilot new training approaches that expand reach and boost learner engagement
* Use feedback, participation data, completion rates, and performance metrics to refine your content
* Coordinate new learning resources with teams across the business
* Travel up to 25% of the time to train main clients in person and support go-live

**Experience You Bring**
------------------------

* 5+ years in customer service, customer success or training within a SaaS business
* 2+ years creating and delivering training, onboarding or certification programs
* 2+ years using a learning management system (LMS) to design, build and deliver training
* Familiarity with Intellum is a plus
* Experience creating accessible learning content, including captions, transcripts, alt text, clear formatting and inclusive design
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including presenting to live and virtual audiences and engaging learners of all backgrounds
* Experience measuring training effectiveness with learner feedback, engagement data, completion rates or performance metrics
* Knowledge of adult learning principles, instructional design methods and best practices for virtual learning

jobs.title: Temporary Instructional Designer
jobs.description:
The range for this role is $59,500 to $81,000
  
Actual base pay will be determined based on a successful candidate's work location, skills/abilities, experience, and education.
  
This is a temporary assignment scheduled to last approximately 60 days based on business needs.
  
Interested applicants must be located in an eligible state of employment with Christian Care Ministry: AL, AZ, CO, FL, GA, IL, IN, KY, MO, NC, OH, OK, SC, SD, TN, TX, VA, WI, WV. Candidates who are within a 40 mile radius of the Melbourne, FL or Orlando, FL offices are encouraged to work onsite at least four days a week.
  
  
The Mission
  
At Christian Care Ministry, we strive to follow the early church example that we see in the book of Acts in the Bible, that modeled Christians helping one another and sharing in one another’s burdens. Through the use of Medi-Share®, a healthcare sharing ministry for Christians, we look to live out that early church example. To that end, our Mission Statement is as follows: Connecting people to a Christ-centered community wellness experience based on faith, prayer, and personal responsibility.
  
The Team
  
Everyone at Christian Care Ministry is in agreement with our Statement of Faith, which outlines our core beliefs. Although we aren’t perfect people, we are serving our perfect God and our Members to the best of our ability.
  
  
The Job
  
  
Summary
  
The Instructional Designer is a temporary role that will design and implement engaging, effective learning and performance support solutions. This role collaborates with subject matter experts and stakeholders to assess needs and develop learning content to meet those needs.
  
  
The Fellowship of the Believers
  
Based on James 5:13-16, every staff member must affirm the Ministry’s Statement of Faith and Conduct & Character Agreement and will be expected to participate in and/or lead prayer with internal and external customers when appropriate. (Because this will take place during the workday, these opportunities are included in the calculation of hours worked).
  
  
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  

* Conduct needs assessments and job task analyses to identify learning and performance gaps

new_jobs.title: Partner Enablement Specialist 3
new_jobs.description:
Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**What's the opportunity?**
---------------------------

Implementation is an activity every Fin customer experiences, whether they're buying Fin for the first time, expanding Fin to a new team, or adopting new features. More and more of those deployments are delivered by our partners, including the Salesforce partner community now ramping up on Fin. A partner-led deployment is only as good as the partner delivering it.

As a Partner Services Manager focused on Enablement, you'll own how our partners get certified and stay current. Your work runs from a partner's first day with Fin, through to the moment they're ready to lead customer deployments, and then every product release after that. Your primary responsibility is making sure every partner who works with a Fin customer has the knowledge, skills and readiness to deliver real value.

Partner Services Managers have an outsized impact on the company. If you want to help make business personal for our customers and you want to work with an ever growing and changing team, you're in the right place!

**What will I be doing?**
-------------------------

* You will own partner enablement end to end: how partners get certified, and how they stay current as Fin evolves
* You will onboard new partners with structured onboarding plans that take them from signed agreement to first deployment, covering Fin's product, our deployment methodology and our delivery standards
* You will run partner certification, including bootcamps, assessments and scenario-based testing. You'll certify named consultants individually, not just partner firms
* You will run Fin Deployment Partner Bootcamps, both in person and virtually, including joint bootcamps with Salesforce for its partner community
* You will build and maintain enablement content, including curricula, online courses, playbooks, hands-on labs and demo environments, and keep it up to date as new features ship
* You will check partner readiness before partners are assigned customer work. That means running readiness assessments, organising shadow and reverse-shadow on live deployments, and confirming that a partner has certified people and capacity in place
* You will track each partner's progress from enabled (delivering under Fin's oversight) to certified (delivering independently), and keep partner and consultant certification records accurate
* You will keep partners current through recertification, release briefings and regular partner office hours
* You will use delivery data, such as Partner CSAT, Fin outcomes, escalations and QA findings, to spot skill gaps and turn them into targeted enablement
* You will own enablement KPIs, including time to certification, certification pass rate, time to first deployment and post-certification delivery quality
* You will work closely with the rest of the Deployment Services team, especially fellow Partner Services Managers and AI Deployment Consultants, to turn lessons from the field into better enablement
* You'll collaborate with our Product, R&D and Education teams to get early access to new features and enable partners on them ahead of launch
* You will cover enablement progress, certification status and skill gaps in each partner's Quarterly Business Review

**What skills do I need?**
--------------------------

* 4+ years of work experience, with 2+ years in implementation, partner enablement or technical training roles
* Enablement Design: experience building training or certification programmes, ideally for partners, consultants or other technical audiences
* Facilitation: confident leading workshops and multi-day bootcamps for technical audiences, both in person and virtually
* Content Creation: the ability to turn complex product and deployment practices into clear courses, guides and hands-on exercises
* Assessment: the judgement to tell whether someone can actually do the work, not just pass a quiz, and the confidence to give direct feedback
* Technical Fluency: comfortable with core SaaS and AI concepts (APIs, integrations, LLM basics, automation logic), enough to speak credibly with technical partner teams
* Programme Management: organised and detail-oriented, able to run several partner cohorts and certification tracks at once
* Positivity and Engagement: a genuine interest in the work you do and a positive attitude!
* Curiosity: a passion for learning, for technology and for solving problems
* Adaptability: change is constant, and the Deployment Services Team values experimentation to find the best processes and solutions
* Demonstrate the Fin Values: Customer Obsessed, Success First, Incredibly High Standards, Open Mindedness, Resilience, Impatience, Positive and Optimistic

**Bonus skills & attributes**
-----------------------------

* Experience running a partner enablement or certification p

new_jobs.title: Project Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Brailsford & Dunlavey (B&D) is seeking a** **Project Coordinator** **—an opportunity for a highly organized, proactive professional who enjoys keeping complex project work moving, managing details, and serving as a trusted resource to project teams and clients. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who communicates clearly, balances multiple priorities with confidence, and brings strong financial and project coordination capabilities to a fast-paced environment.**


This is a hybrid role based in our San Francisco, CA office.

**The Opportunity**

At B&D, we lead the planning, development, and management of the places that shape and strengthen communities—where people live, learn, work, and play. B&D recently joined forces with Project Management Advisors (PMA), bringing together two nationally recognized leaders in program management and real estate advisory services and expanding our capabilities across the full project lifecycle.

As a Project Coordinator, you will provide day-to-day coordination and administrative support. You will work closely with project managers, clients, consultants, contractors, and administrative staff to keep project information, financial tracking, documentation, meetings, and key deliverables organized and moving forward.

**How You’ll Contribute**

* Coordinate project schedules, deliverables, documentation, correspondence, and follow-up activities across project teams.
* Create and maintain organized electronic project files and project documentation in accordance with established procedures.
* Support project financial management by assisting with budgets, cash-flow estimates, commitment schedules, monthly draw packages, payables, and financial reporting.
* Gather and review information from project stakeholders to support accurate reporting and timely processing of key deliverables.
* Coordinate meetings, conference calls, appointments, and site visits; prepare agendas, presentation materials, and supporting documents.
* Attend project meetings, prepare and distribute meeting minutes, and track action items through completion.
* Support coordination among clients, designers, contractors, consultants, vendors, and internal project team members.
* Assist with consultant, contractor, and vendor solicitation, procurement, contract administration, and approval tracking.
* Monitor project details, scope changes, requests for information, submittals, and other information flows to help keep work on schedule.
* Support project controls and reporting related to status, cost, schedule, and open items.
* Assist with proposals, contracts, and project closeout activities as needed.
* Build responsive, professional relationships with clients and internal stakeholders while handling confidential information with discretion.

What we are looking for:

* 4+ years of relevant industry experience, ideally within construction, owner’s representation, program management, architecture/engineering, real estate development, or a related professional services environment.
* 2+ years of financial experience, including budget tracking, project financial analysis, reporting, invoicing, draw preparation, or similar responsibilities.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred but not required; coursework or a degree in business, accounting, finance, engineering, architecture, construction, or a related field is beneficial.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* General understanding of project management processes, project controls, construction documentation, and sequencing.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and produce high-quality work in a fast-paced project environment.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while collaborating effectively with a broader project team.
* Sound judgment, professionalism, integrity, and discretion when handling sensitive information.
* Client-service mindset and ability to build productive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

**What Sets You Apart**

You anticipate what the team needs before being asked and reliably follow work through to completion. **What You'll Do**

The Contracts and Legal Operations Manager will support CATF's General Counsel and work directly with program and operations teams on contracts, grants, compliance, and day-to-day legal operations. The role combines hands-on contract administration with responsibility for helping staff navigate legal intake and compliance processes, maintaining accurate records, and improving the systems that support this work. You will handle routine matters independently, use sound judgment to identify issues, and escalate more complex legal questions to the General Counsel. Overall, this role helps CATF manage contracts and compliance work consistently and efficiently across the organization.

**Responsibilities**

* **Contracts & Grant Operations** – Manage the administrative lifecycle of contracts and grants, including intake, approval routing, signature coordination, executed-document management, supporting documentation for payment release, and tracking.

* **Compliance Operations** – Manage administrative support for lobbying and electoral compliance, monitor registered agent portals for new issues or filings, and maintain accurate compliance-related information and records.

* **Training & Staff Enablement** – Develop and lead training and office hours that help staff understand legal intake processes and compliance workflows, and prepare supporting guidance, materials, and presentations.
* **Systems & Process Improvement** – Improve workflows and operational efficiency, support system implementations and updates, and help manage contract and document management systems, including reporting and tracking.
* **Policy, Template & Records Management** – Support updates to contract templates, organizational policies, procedures, and guidelines; maintain organized legal files; and manage the internal trademark tracker, including application statuses, renewal deadlines, and office actions.
* **Research & Legal Operations Support** – Conduct legal, industry, and historical research; monitor relevant legal cases and developments; and provide additional administrative support to the General Counsel as needed.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

You will be successful in this role if you can manage detailed legal and operational work while keeping processes moving across multiple teams. The work requires sound judgment, strong organization, and the ability to distinguish between matters you can resolve independently and those that need to be elevated to the General Counsel.

**Required Experience**

* Demonstrated ability to manage contracts, grants, or comparable document-based workflows from intake through approval, execution, recordkeeping, and follow-up.
* Experience drafting or preparing standard agreements, contracts, grants, or similar documents using established templates and guidance.
* Ability to exercise professional judgment, resolve routine issues independently, and recognize when legal or compliance matters require escalation.
* Experience maintaining accurate records, trackers, document management systems, or similar operational systems.
* Ability to work directly with colleagues across different functions and explain processes, requirements, and next steps clearly.
* Experience developing or improving workflows, procedures, training materials, or operational guidance.
* Ability to conduct research, organize findings, and monitor ongoing developments relevant to legal or compliance work.

**What We Provide**
-------------------

This role supports the legal and compliance infrastructure that allows CATF's teams to carry out their work effectively. You will work directly with program and operations colleagues across the organization and have opportunities to improve the processes and systems that support contracts and legal operations.

The position is remote, with an East Coast location preferred.

new_jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

Do you want to support Vermont communities and listing officials? Do you want to ensure equity in property taxes? There has never been a better time to bring your values and talents to the collaborative team at the Vermont Department of Taxes. We are seeking a senior assessor to work closely with listers and assessors and to help lead the Commercial Appraisal and Litigation Assistance Program (CALAP). If you have a passion for working with municipalities and a talent for managing programs, we want to hear from you!

  

The Commercial Appraisal and Litigation Assistance Program, created by Act 163 of 2022, supports municipalities in appraising high-value commercial properties to establish fair and defensible values. This is one of two positions that supports this program. The CALAP Manager is responsible for the day-to-day aspects of the program, including but not limited to working with appraisal vendors and municipalities to ensure projects happen timely. This position will work closely with the PVR Division Director, the Field Director, other PVR division supervisors, department legal staff including the CALAP attorney, and external partners including municipal officials and appraisal vendors. They will also work closely with 10-15 municipalities, serving as their district advisor.

  

**Key responsibilities of this position include but are not limited to:**

* Providing training, education, and support to municipal officials to maintain the statewide grand list for the purpose of education funding.
* Conducting detailed analyses of municipal assessment practices through the annual Equalization Study.
* Evaluating and updating utility valuation methodologies.
* Reviewing applications to the program.
* Coordinating with vendors to ensure timely completion of projects.
* Reviewing appraisals for accuracy and completion.
* Participating in the appeals process as needed.
  

**The ideal candidate will have:**

* Experience in real estate appraisal or assessment, with some experience in reviewing appraisals especially for utility properties.
* Experience in managing multiple projects simultaneously.
* Experience working with multiple vendors to ensure projects are completed timely.
* Some experience in reviewing appraisals especially for commercial properties.
* A desire to learn and grow and have experience fostering that desire in others.
* A proven record of prioritizing work, managing deadlines, and aligning expectations of internal and external stakeholders.
* Knowledge of or willingness to learn about tax law and policies.
  

This is a full-time field-based position central to the southern portion or the northern portion of the State. Applicants will need to have reliable personal transportation to attend periodic meetings in the Montpelier main office and to conduct on-site visits with town officials generally in the Northern or Southern portions of the State. Click here to learn more about the technical and professional requirements of the CALAP Senior Assessor. For additional information about employee satisfaction and benefits, please see our website.

**About the Division of Property Valuation and Review**
-------------------------------------------------------

Property Valuation and Review (PVR) provides support to municipalities in developing and administrating property tax policies and related programs at the local level and has created an educational training and certification program that is available to municipal listers and assessors. PVR conducts annual ratio studies which estimate taxable property values and appraisals for school districts. It also administers the Use Value Appraisal Program (Current Use) which created almost $78 million in tax savings to landowners. PVR is currently implementing a new integrated property tax management system, and is planning modernization and digitization, making NOW the opportune time to join the team.

  

**Additional Information**
  
Compensation: The hourly salary rate for this position ranges from $33.53 to $52.55 and State of Vermont benefits are very competitive. The annualized salary for this potion ranges from approximately $69,742.40 to $109,304. The salary range reflects the minimum and maximum salary potential in the assigned pay grade, and the annualized salary figure is calculated based on 2080 hours of annual compensation and does not include authorized overtime or other compensation. It also doesn’t include any time taken off payroll. The starting salary for this position may be negotiable depending on experience and qualifications. This position is eligible for an office allowance and will be reimbursed for allowable business travel expenses.

  

**Background Checks:** This position will primarily support the Department of Taxes. Candidates must agree to be fingerprinted and pass a background check to be eligible for this position, which will involve access to sensitive federal tax information. Background checks are required by the Internal Revenue Service and are authorized under Vermont law. 3 V.S.A. § 241. In accordance with VDT Standard Operating Procedure 2018-01, Background Investigations, Vermont and national criminal record checks will be conducted on all candidates. Candidates will have the right to withdraw their application before fingerprinting or a background check is conducted.

  

We value diverse teams and are committed to creating a community of inclusion.

**Who May Apply**
-----------------

This position, **Commercial Appraisal and Litigation Assistance Program Manager (Job Requisition #56091)**, is open to all State employees and external applicants.

  

If you would like more information about this position, please contact Christie.Wright@vermont.gov.

Resumes will not be accepted via e-mail. You must apply online to be considered.

  

Please note that multiple positions in the same work location may be filled from this job posting.

new_jobs.description:
Overview:

Thank you for considering IT Concepts dba Kentro, where innovation drives opportunity and collaboration leads to success. Our dynamic community of experts is fully committed to advancing our customers' missions, fostering professional growth, and making a positive impact on our communities.

By joining our supportive community, you will find that Kentro is dedicated to your personal and professional development. Together, we can drive meaningful change, spark innovation, and achieve extraordinary milestones.

Kentro is hiring for a **HAM Technical Field Implementation Specialist** to support the **VA ESOM** **contract**. The HAM Technical Field Implementation Specialist serves as a trusted advisor for Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) field organizations as they transition to ServiceNow Hardware Asset Management (HAM) as the enterprise system of record. The Specialist leads change management at the site level, training field staff on new processes, tools, and expectations while maintaining operational continuity.  
  
Kentro configured ServiceNow HAM for the VA, and this role is central to translating that configuration into consistent, policy-aligned practice in the field. The Specialist interprets VA asset management policy and directives, advises end users on compliant processes, and resolves complex and non-standard issues through root cause analysis and technical research, including issues involving device operating systems and how endpoint data is reflected in hardware asset records. The Specialist prioritizes incoming requests, tests and refines guidance to ensure end users receive accurate direction, and documents best practices that strengthen adoption and data quality across the enterprise.

**Location:** **Remote** - This position can be performed remotely within the United States and will support Eastern Time working hours.

**Compensation Range:** The anticipated base salary range for this position is $70,000 –$120,000 annually and reflects Kentro’s good-faith expectations at the time of posting. Final compensation is determined based on the role’s requirements, relevant skills, experience, education, certifications, work location, applicable security clearance requirements, market conditions, internal equity, and contract requirements.

This Job Description reflects the primary duties of the role; however, it is not intended to be all‑inclusive. Team members may be asked to take on additional responsibilities in alignment with customer expectations, business needs, and Kentro’s culture of collaboration and adaptability.

Responsibilities:

Change Management and Adoption

* Lead site-level change management activities that prepare field staff to adopt ServiceNow HAM, including readiness assessments, targeted communications, and reinforcement of new processes.
* Identify adoption barriers and sources of resistance, and partner with the Change Management team to develop targeted interventions that sustain behavior change.
* Deliver training, coaching, and just-in-time support so field staff can independently navigate ServiceNow HAM, submit requests, and track status.
* Reinforce job aids, standard operating procedures, and training materials, and recommend updates based on field feedback and observed adoption trends.
* Monitor adoption indicators and field sentiment, escalating risks and recommending course corrections to program leadership.

Policy Interpretation and Compliance

* Interpret VA and federal asset management policies, directives, and procedures, and translate requirements into clear, actionable guidance for field staff.
* Ensure field practices and ServiceNow HAM usage align with applicable policy, identifying gaps and recommending corrective actions.
* Advise stakeholders on how policy applies to non-standard scenarios, documenting interpretations to promote consistency across sites.

Client Relationships and Field Engagement

* Build and sustain trusted relationships with VA field stakeholders.
* Select the most effective communication channel (e.g., chat, email, phone, or virtual meeting) based on issue urgency and stakeholder needs.
* Prioritize field requests, change management activities, and programmatic tasks based on urgency, operational impact, and site needs.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and provide proactive, timely updates through issue resolution.

Technical Issue Research and Resolution

* Conduct root cause analysis and investigative research to resolve standard and non-standard asset, inventory, and ServiceNow HAM issues.
* Apply working knowledge of device operating systems (e.g., Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android) to diagnose issues with device identification and discovery, explain how endpoint data populates hardware asset records, and advise on operating system considerations that affect asset lifecycle decisions.
* Test, validate, and iterate on resolution approaches and end-user guidance within ServiceNow to confirm accuracy before broader dissemination.
* Escalate configuration defects and enhancement opportunities to the appropriate technical teams with clear supporting documentation.

For decades, construction and field services contractors have had to run their businesses on outdated software: clunky, on-premise systems created in the 1980s and 1990s.

That’s where Miter comes in. We’re using AI and embedded payments to rebuild the core HR, finance, and operations systems that underpin our physical economy. Using Miter, contractors like Marathon Electrical, W.J. O’Neil, and Truebeck Construction are building stronger teams, controlling job costs, and accelerating jobsite execution.

This idea is resonating. Since we launched in 2021, we’ve grown to thousands of customers and tens of millions in ARR, making us one of the fastest growing vertical software companies ever. new_jobs.title: Temporary Instructional Designer
new_jobs.description:
The range for this role is $59,500 to $81,000
  
Actual base pay will be determined based on a successful candidate's work location, skills/abilities, experience, and education.
  
This is a temporary assignment scheduled to last approximately 60 days based on business needs.
  
Interested applicants must be located in an eligible state of employment with Christian Care Ministry: AL, AZ, CO, FL, GA, IL, IN, KY, MO, NC, OH, OK, SC, SD, TN, TX, VA, WI, WV. Candidates who are within a 40 mile radius of the Melbourne, FL or Orlando, FL offices are encouraged to work onsite at least four days a week.
  
  
The Mission
  
At Christian Care Ministry, we strive to follow the early church example that we see in the book of Acts in the Bible, that modeled Christians helping one another and sharing in one another’s burdens. Through the use of Medi-Share®, a healthcare sharing ministry for Christians, we look to live out that early church example. To that end, our Mission Statement is as follows: Connecting people to a Christ-centered community wellness experience based on faith, prayer, and personal responsibility.
  
The Team
  
Everyone at Christian Care Ministry is in agreement with our Statement of Faith, which outlines our core beliefs. Although we aren’t perfect people, we are serving our perfect God and our Members to the best of our ability.
  
  
The Job
  
  
Summary
  
The Instructional Designer is a temporary role that will design and implement engaging, effective learning and performance support solutions. This role collaborates with subject matter experts and stakeholders to assess needs and develop learning content to meet those needs.
  
  
The Fellowship of the Believers
  
Based on James 5:13-16, every staff member must affirm the Ministry’s Statement of Faith and Conduct & Character Agreement and will be expected to participate in and/or lead prayer with internal and external customers when appropriate. (Because this will take place during the workday, these opportunities are included in the calculation of hours worked).
  
  
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  

* Conduct needs assessments and job task analyses to identify learning and performance gaps
* Design and develop learning experiences for classroom, virtual, and eLearning delivery
* Create and maintain content such as facilitator guides, participant materials, job aids, and knowledge base articles
* Apply adult learning principles and instructional design best practices to all deliverables
* Conduct media analyses to ensure content is relevant, accurate, and achieves objectives
* Conduct formative and summative evaluation of course content
* Develop and manage learning paths and performance support tools in LMS and knowledge systems
* Use data analytics to evaluate training effectiveness and recommend improvements
* Collaborate with stakeholders to align learning solutions with business objectives
* Provide support and guidance to peers and end users on learning technologies and content
* Maintain and update content based on feedback, performance metrics, and organizational changes
* Ensure course development and maintenance train the appropriate skills and competencies stated in the learning experience objectives
* Support compliance training and reporting in coordination with HR and department leaders
* Manage instructional design project scope, requirements, goals and timeline
* Contribute to the exercise and expression of Christian Care Ministry’s Christian beliefs
* All other duties as assigned

Essential Skills & Abilities
  

* Proficiency in instructional systems design and adult learning theory
* Strong consultation, analytical, and communication skills
* Experience with LMS administration (e.g., Litmos, LinkedIn Learning) and eLearning tools (e.g., Articulate 360, Camtasia)
* Ability to manage multiple projects – conduct needs assessment and analysis, manage stakeholder expectations, prioritize efforts to meet timelines, and measure outcomes.
* Collaborate across teams – work with stakeholders and subject matter experts to deliver excellent work product and build relationships
* Familiarity with SCORM/xAPI standards and knowledge management systems
* Competence in Microsoft Office, SharePoint, Teams, and graphic design tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Canva)
* Ability to translate data into actionable insights and learning improvements
* Attention to detail – ensure accuracy and consistency to all instructional material

Core Competencies/Demonstrable Behaviors
  

* Collaborates – Builds partnerships and works collaboratively with others to meet objectives
* Communicates effectively – Delivers clear, audience-appropriate communications
* Member First – exhibits full commitment to serving members and/or clients by prioritizing their needs first in alignment with our program’s purpose. This commitment is demonstrated through understanding of the program(s), provided through quality and timely service while exercising empathy in every interaction. Every CCM employee shares responsibility to steward resources faithfully, removing barriers to understanding, and creating accessible, connected, and Christ-centered experiences.
* Nimble learning – Learns through experimentation and adapts quickly
* Plans and aligns – Prioritizes work to meet strategic goals
* Humble – demonstrates Christ-Centered humility by honoring others, accepting feedback, and prioritizing collective success over individual recognition
* Hungry – exhibits initiative, perseverance, and commitment to serving God through excellence. Demonstrates passion for personal and organizational growth while diligently advancing the mission of Christian Care Ministry
* Smart – shows relational and emotional intelligence, communicates effectively, collaborates harmoniously, and reads social cues with grace and discernment

Education and/or Experience
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Education, Organizational Development, or related field
